reason: Independent review found the Docker UI runtime cannot reach host Ollama at the hardcoded container loopback and has no supported OS keyring backend. It also stores agent/provider/job data in ephemeral container storage. Fail closed and direct users to a supported host-local runtime; persist Docker app data across recreation.
required_invalidations: Add AC08 runtime capability/persistence work item.
Invalidate AC04 review until the final runtime changes and exact candidate fingerprint are reviewed.
Verify the final build/compose manifest and report unrun native credential/cloud operations.
decision: Accepted as an implementation correction within the user-authorized local Ollama configuration feature.
